issues: latest-tag: Deployment/payments-api: The container "api" is using an invalid container image, "nginx:latest". Please use images that are not blocked by the `BlockList` criteria : [".*:(latest)$" "^[^:]*$" "(.*/[^:]+)$"]

run-as-non-root: Deployment/payments-api: container "api" is not set to runAsNonRoot

attempts.rationale: Set automountServiceAccountToken false, changed runAsUser to 1000 and runAsNonRoot true, set allowPrivilegeEscalation false, added CPU/memory limits and requests, pinned image tag to nginx:1.23.4, set readOnlyRootFilesystem true.
attempts.proposed_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  namespace: payments
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payments-api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: nginx:1.23.4
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "50m"
              memory: "64Mi"

findings.message: No NetworkPolicy in this manifest bundle: consider a default-deny NetworkPolicy

drifts.detail: service account token is no longer mounted: breaks the app if it calls the Kubernetes API
image tag changed latest -> 1.23.4: behaviour depends on what that tag contains
now runs as non-root (runAsUser 1000): the image must support that user
root filesystem is read-only and no writable volume is mounted: apps that write temp/log/cache files will crash
resource limits added: too-low values cause OOMKills or CPU throttling

intent.note: No high-impact static drift detected. Behaviour in a cluster is still not proven.
